title: Grateful Dead Live at Dane County Coliseum on 1973-10-25

ai_review.summary: Soundboard upgrade delivers a clearer capture of an underrated second set, though the minimalist Dark Star leaves some listeners disappointed.
ai_review.review: The new SBD master provides noticeably improved clarity over earlier reel‑to‑DAT releases, making the performance easier to enjoy. While the second set is praised as highly underrated and features an unexpected MLB jam, the opening Dark Star is described as overly sparse and noisy, resulting in mixed feelings about the show overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews average ~3.7 stars; most praise the upgraded soundboard source and the set’s underrated status, but criticism of Dark Star drags the overall impression down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Upgrade from previous SBD master reel → DAT → CD‑R noted; listeners report clearer, more listenable audio with no major flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set opens with a minimalist Dark Star that many found noisy and disappointing, then abruptly shifts into an energetic MLB jam; overall the set is considered underrated despite its uneven start.
